description: A grand, light-filled double-height foyer with a sweeping curved staircase as its centerpiece. The staircase curves in a wide spiral from the ground floor up to the second level — its treads are medium-toned walnut or dark honey-brown wood, and its railing system consists of slim matte-black iron balusters with a continuous rounded walnut handrail. A circular matte-black iron railing wall at ground floor encircles the stair base. The stair soffit is smooth white plaster, curving in a smooth arc. Behind the staircase, a very tall multi-pane steel-framed window wall fills the void with abundant natural green-filtered daylight, offering a view of mature garden trees outside. The foyer walls are smooth white plaster, and the floor is wide-plank pale blonde oak in a straight-lay pattern. To the lower left, a tall ceramic vessel or urn in warm terracotta tones holds a dried branchy arrangement, placed on or beside a light wood console. A framed artwork in a simple frame hangs at the left wall. Multiple faceted or angular alabaster or frosted-stone forms in matte-black conical caps hang at dramatically staggered heights through the full double-height void of the stairwell, each glowing with warm amber translucent light. Camera at standing eye-level, centered wide-establishing view of the full staircase run and foyer floor, normal lens, level pitch. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category.
